issues.comment: Missing `cd <repo-dir>` step after `git clone`. Without it, a contributor running `make install` immediately after cloning will be in the wrong directory. For a quickstart aimed at people avoiding the full README, this will cause a confusing failure. Add a step: `cd demo-app` (or whatever the cloned directory name is) between steps 1 and 2.

`git clone` step omits the clone URL. New contributors who found the quickstart via a doc link rather than the repo page won't know what to clone. Consider adding the full URL or a placeholder: `git clone https://github.com/demo-org/demo-app`.

Port 3000 in `http://localhost:3000` should be verified against the actual dev server config (e.g., `vite.config.js`, `package.json` dev script, or `.env.example`). If the port differs, new contributors will waste time wondering why the browser shows nothing.

`make install` and `make dev` targets should be confirmed to exist in the Makefile. If they were renamed or the project uses a different tool (e.g., `npm install` / `npm run dev`), the quickstart will be wrong on day one.
